people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?
translations.bsb: “Were not all ten cleansed?” Jesus asked. “Where then are the other nine?
translations.kjv: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?
